stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 全周期巩固第 105 天预定间隔复习词群，强化多义辨析与跨场景（AI/时序/具身智能论文、演讲、六级/雅思托福）主动写作。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G033】去除“AI 味（Anti-AI-ese）”与过度修辞：用具体机制、指标与实例替代空洞夸张；【G002】可数名词、不可数名词及多义词在不同义项下的可数性切换。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP009】谨慎归因与多因素解释（May Account For / Be Attributable To），彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

domain_transfer_guidance.ml_timeseries_embodied_transfer: 在深度学习/时序预测/具身智能论文中，使用搭配“from the outset”精确表述“从一开始”（例如描述分布假设、传感器时间序列滞后、物理运动约束或消融实验对比，直接陈述指标变化而不堆砌空洞形容词）。
domain_transfer_guidance.cet6_ielts_toefl_speech_transfer: 在六级/雅思托福议论文或学术演讲（Tech Talk）中，用“from the outset”替代口语化的模糊动词或中式模板，紧跟具体政策、教育或技术落地实例支撑论点。

collocations.meaning_note_zh: 自然学术搭配：from the outset（从一开始）

annotations.special_note: 学术语境与搭配约束：不是从此以后 from then on。

auxiliary_words_glossed.note: 语境辅助生词（提前释义以辅助理解例句，不计入目标词掌握情况）

grammar_instruction.name: 去除“AI 味（Anti-AI-ese）”与过度修辞：用具体机制、指标与实例替代空洞夸张
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 典型 AI 生成文本充斥着空洞的套话与浮夸副词/形容词（如 delve into, testament to, tapestry, underscores the paramount importance, revolutionize, unparalleled, groundbreaking），却缺乏具体技术细节。地道顶会论文（NeurIPS/ICLR/CoRL）与高分雅思/托福/六级写作追求“低修辞密度、高信息密度”：用具体动词、明确指标和真实实例说话。
rules: 删除无实质信息的“清嗓子”套话（Throat-clearing）：少用 *It is worth noting that / It is undeniable that / In the realm of modern artificial intelligence*，直接陈述事实主干。

禁止“只有夸张形容词而不给实例或数据支撑”：不要写 *The model achieves an enormous, unparalleled improvement*，而要写 *The proposed parametrization reduces MSE by 8.4% relative to the seasonal naive baseline on hourly electricity demand*。
优先选用朴素、精准的单音节或核心学术动词（examine, test, compare, constrain, decompose, bound, mitigate）替代故作高深的修辞词。
examples:
AI 腔/空洞夸张：*This groundbreaking paradigm delves into the intricate tapestry of temporal dynamics and achieves unparalleled accuracy.*
地道学术改写：*This model decomposes the series into trend and seasonal components, achieving lower forecasting error than the linear baseline on three benchmarks.*

六级/雅思空洞句：*Technology has an enormous impact on education in many ways.*
地道具体展开：*Asynchronous learning platforms allow part-time students to review lecture recordings at their own pace, reducing scheduling conflicts.*
common_errors: 堆砌 paramount, unprecedented, revolutionize, multifaceted 等宣传式词汇，违反客观学术语域。
只下宏大判断（如 *This method is very efficient*）而不给出具体的计算复杂度、内存占用或延迟数据。

grammar_instruction.name: 可数名词、不可数名词及多义词在不同义项下的可数性切换
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 不仅要区分绝对不可数名词（evidence, information, research, literature, equipment, apparatus, documentation, feedback, knowledge）与可数名词（study, finding, discrepancy, anomaly, covariate），更要掌握“同一单词在不同词义下的可数性切换”（Rule A.2）。
rules: 不可数学术名词不加 a/an 或复数 -s（严禁写 *an evidence, *researches, *equipments, *feedbacks）；表单项用 a piece/item of evidence, a research study, a piece of equipment。
一词多义下的可数性切换：discipline 表“纪律”不可数，表“学科”可数（two academic disciplines）；work 表“研究工作”不可数，workings 表“计算步骤”；experience 表“经验”不可数，表“经历”可数（experiences in childhood）；paper 表“纸”不可数，表“论文”可数。
量词精确匹配：修饰不可数用 a great deal of, a large amount of, much, less and less；修饰可数复数用 a large number of, a handful of, many, fewer and fewer。
examples: The transcription required a great deal of effort.
A large number of records still require checking.
The project draws on two academic disciplines.
All apparatus was checked before the experiment.
common_errors: 量词与可数性错配：*a great deal of participants / *an amount of respondents / *fewer time。
不可数名词误加复数：*many evidences / *new equipments / *useful feedbacks。

grammar_instruction.name: 语序、否定辖域、部分否定与句首否定倒装
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 精确控制否定与限定副词（only, solely, merely, by no means, under no circumstances, rarely, seldom）的辖域。当否定或唯一下界短语置于句首时，主句必须采用部分倒装。
rules: 区分全部否定（none of, in no way, under no circumstances, by no means）与部分否定（not all, not necessarily, not always）。
当 by no means, in no way, under no circumstances, in no circumstances, on no account, rarely, seldom, only when... 置于句首时，主句必须部分倒装（助动词/be/情态动词提至主语前）。
间接疑问从句（assess to what extent the results depend on...）一律保持陈述语序，不倒装。
examples: By no means is the result certain. (对比句中：A large sample is by no means sufficient to eliminate systematic bias.)
Under no circumstances should test labels be used for model tuning.
Only when the protocol was approved did recruitment begin.
common_errors: 句首否定强调漏掉倒装：*Under no circumstances test labels should be used。
间接疑问句误用倒装：*examine how does the system behave（应为 how the system behaves）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 谨慎归因与多因素解释（May Account For / Be Attributable To）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: The observed discrepancy may be attributable to / stem from [Factor A] rather than [Factor B].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 在分析实验误差或异常现象时，客观提出可能成因而不武断定论。
examples: The observed discrepancy may be attributable to differences in measurement procedures.
Measurement error may account for part of the discrepancy.
common_errors: *attributable for / 把可能成因直接写成唯一确定原因。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 显式声明模型假设、研究范围与成立前提
expression_pattern_instruction.template: We confine the analysis to [domain/regime]; the bound holds provided that [regularity/stationarity assumption] is satisfied.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于理论推导或实证边界说明，体现科学严谨性。
examples: We confine the analysis to observations collected before the policy change.
A sufficient condition guarantees the stated result when that condition holds.
common_errors: 隐瞒模型成立的强假设。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：来自阅读习题；for 表持续时段，不能译成某个特定年份。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Researchers have studied this issue for some years.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V01060 adv.phr.] 大体上；大部分情况下（例：For the most part, the responses were consistent across groups.）；[V01061 phrase] 大体上，在大多数情况下（例：For the most part, the archived records were legible.）；[V01062 phrase] 大体上；大部分（例：The responses were, for the most part, brief.）；[V01063 状语短语] 主要；大部分情况下（例：For the most part, the responses concerned access to housing.） | 本条用法约束：不表示所有情况；应保留已知例外。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: For the most part, the responses were consistent across groups.

scheduled_review_words.meaning_zh: 大体上，在大多数情况下
scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V01060 adv.phr.] 大体上；大部分情况下（例：For the most part, the responses were consistent across groups.）；[V01061 phrase] 大体上，在大多数情况下（例：For the most part, the archived records were legible.）；[V01062 phrase] 大体上；大部分（例：The responses were, for the most part, brief.）；[V01063 状语短语] 主要；大部分情况下（例：For the most part, the responses concerned access to housing.） | 本条用法约束：限定范围，不能据此写所有记录都清晰。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: For the most part, the archived records were legible.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V01060 adv.phr.] 大体上；大部分情况下（例：For the most part, the responses were consistent across groups.）；[V01061 phrase] 大体上，在大多数情况下（例：For the most part, the archived records were legible.）；[V01062 phrase] 大体上；大部分（例：The responses were, for the most part, brief.）；[V01063 状语短语] 主要；大部分情况下（例：For the most part, the responses concerned access to housing.） | 本条用法约束：限定整体判断。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The responses were, for the most part, brief.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V01060 adv.phr.] 大体上；大部分情况下（例：For the most part, the responses were consistent across groups.）；[V01061 phrase] 大体上，在大多数情况下（例：For the most part, the archived records were legible.）；[V01062 phrase] 大体上；大部分（例：The responses were, for the most part, brief.）；[V01063 状语短语] 主要；大部分情况下（例：For the most part, the responses concerned access to housing.） | 本条用法约束：保留少数不同情况。
key_collocations: for the most part, the responses
scheduled_review_words.example_en: For the most part, the responses concerned access to housing.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V01064 prep. phrase] 为了……的目的；就……而言（例：For the purposes of this essay, access means physical access.）；[V01065 介词短语] 为了…的目的（例：For the purposes of this analysis, we exclude duplicate records.） | 本条用法约束：用于规定本篇分析范围，不声称这是唯一词义。
key_collocations: for the purposes of this essay
scheduled_review_words.example_en: For the purposes of this essay, access means physical access.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V01064 prep. phrase] 为了……的目的；就……而言（例：For the purposes of this essay, access means physical access.）；[V01065 介词短语] 为了…的目的（例：For the purposes of this analysis, we exclude duplicate records.） | 本条用法约束：说明限定的研究目的或操作范围。
key_collocations: for the purposes of this analysis
scheduled_review_words.example_en: For the purposes of this analysis, we exclude duplicate records.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：必须有可指代的前述原因。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Several measurements were unstable. For this reason, we repeated them.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：argument 此处为论证，不是争吵。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The student formulated an argument for changing the assessment policy.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：first-year student 为更中性、包容的表达。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The fresher attended the library induction.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：强调观察角度或处境，并非 opinion 的直接替换。
key_collocations: from the residents' point of view
scheduled_review_words.example_en: From the residents' point of view, noise is a major cost.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：不是从此以后 from then on。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The eligibility criteria were specified from the outset.

scheduled_review_words.lemma: from the point of view of
scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：明确视角主体；也可用 from a student perspective。
key_collocations: from the point of view of students
scheduled_review_words.example_en: From the point of view of students, the feedback arrived too late.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：then 必须有已明示的过去时间点。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: From then on, all records were stored centrally.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：用具体问题说明前沿所指，避免空泛宣传。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The seminar examines questions at the frontiers of knowledge.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：fulfill 为美式；meet the requirements 也可用。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The candidate checked whether the documents fulfilled the stated requirements.
